brief:
**BLUF:** Tazewell County saw local high school football results, school staffing news, a park dedication, and community events on Saturday, with no active NWS alerts or major incidents reported. In nearby Mercer County, WV, a grand jury handed down indictments including murder and a multi-state scam, while an overdose spike prompted Narcan distribution. The broader region reported routine traffic planning and political activity ahead of elections.[[1]](https://www.wvva.com/2026/10/23/mercer-county-indictments-include-murder-multi-state-scam/)

## LAW ENFORCEMENT AND COURTS
**Mercer County, WV (Princeton):** A Mercer County grand jury indicted nearly 70 people. Donald Ray Pennington, 59, faces first-degree murder, concealment of a deceased human body, strangulation, and domestic battery charges tied to the May discovery of a missing Bluefield woman’s body in Bland County, VA. Ren Xin Huang, 55, of Flushing, Queens, NY, was indicted on financial exploitation of an elderly person, fraudulent schemes, and conspiracy in a multi-state scam targeting a local resident.[[1]](https://www.wvva.com/2026/10/23/mercer-county-indictments-include-murder-multi-state-scam/)

**Tazewell County, VA:** The Tazewell County Sheriff’s Office warned residents about phone scams in which callers impersonate court or pretrial officials to solicit money or credit card details from families of inmates (reported Oct. 22).[[2]](https://www.wvnstv.com/news/local-news/tazewell-county-virginia/tazewell-county-sheriffs-office-warns-public-about-scam/)

Nothing else reported in the core area in the last 24 hours.

## FIRE, EMS AND RESCUE
Nothing reported in the last 24 hours.

## HAZARDS, WEATHER AND ROADS
Nothing reported in the last 24 hours. NWS alerts: none active. The Bristol District VDOT weekly traffic alert covers Oct. 26–Nov. 1 (issued Oct. 23).[[3]](https://www.si.com/high-school/stats/virginia/football/games/6895119-tazewell-vs-richlands)

## GOVERNMENT AND POLITICS
**Tazewell County, VA:** Tazewell County Public Schools announced a new attendance assistant (Oct. 23).[[4]](https://www.wvva.com/2026/10/23/boys-girls-clubs-greater-bluefield-reverses-trick-or-treating-thank-community/)

**Mercer County, WV (Princeton/Bluefield):** Early voting continues through Oct. 31 at the courthouse, Herbs Simms Wellness Center, and Covenant Baptist Church (weekdays 8:30 a.m.–4:30 p.m.; Saturdays 9 a.m.–5 p.m.).[[5]](https://www.bdtonline.com/news/local_news/mercer-county-prepares-for-early-voting/article_f5b5c5b6-1e42-4291-ae5c-19409bc2f17e.html)

**Region:** U.S. Rep. Morgan Griffith conducted a 17-stop campaign swing across Southwest Virginia (reported Oct. 23).[[3]](https://www.si.com/high-school/stats/virginia/football/games/6895119-tazewell-vs-richlands)

## ECONOMY AND OTHER
**Tazewell, VA:** A statue of Hall of Famer Billy Wagner was unveiled Saturday at the new Billy Wagner Park.[[3]](https://www.si.com/high-school/stats/virginia/football/games/6895119-tazewell-vs-richlands)

**Tazewell County, VA:** Tazewell County Public Schools introduced a new attendance assistant (Oct. 23).[[4]](https://www.wvva.com/2026/10/23/boys-girls-clubs-greater-bluefield-reverses-trick-or-treating-thank-community/)

**Richlands, VA:** Richlands High School defeated Tazewell High School 14-7 in the Backyard Brawl (Oct. 23).[[6]](https://www.25newsnow.com/news/tazewell-county/)

**Bluefield, WV:** Hospital staff wore pink and pearls for Breast Cancer Awareness Month (Oct. 24). Boys and Girls Clubs of Greater Bluefield reversed trick-or-treating, with kids delivering candy to downtown businesses to thank the community (Oct. 23).[[4]](https://www.wvva.com/2026/10/23/boys-girls-clubs-greater-bluefield-reverses-trick-or-treating-thank-community/)

**Princeton, WV:** Visit Mercer County opened Basecamp, a new visitor experience center in downtown Princeton (Oct. 23).[[3]](https://www.si.com/high-school/stats/virginia/football/games/6895119-tazewell-vs-richlands)

**Buchanan County, VA:** A fuel cell energy project is planned for a former high school property (reported Oct. 23).[[3]](https://www.si.com/high-school/stats/virginia/football/games/6895119-tazewell-vs-richlands)

**Tazewell County, VA:** The merged Tazewell County Volunteer Fire Co. (11 former departments now operating as stations under three battalions) began operations; a paid part-time department is planned for spring (reported Oct. 22).[[7]](https://cardinalnews.org/2026/10/22/sjn-tazewell-county-restructuring/)

**Today’s events (core):** Tazewell Comic Con (10 a.m.–4 p.m., Nuckolls Hall, Tazewell); Hibernationfest (5–9 p.m., Greenway Park, Richlands); Harry Potter Night (6 p.m., Tazewell Train Station & Visitors Center, North Tazewell).[[8]](https://www.tazewellchamber.com/events/)

## WATCH -- NEXT 48 HOURS
- Early voting continues in Mercer County through Oct. 31.
- Tazewell County events: Comic Con costume contest at 2 p.m. today; additional Halloween and library programs scheduled.
- VDOT Bristol District work Oct. 26–Nov. 1.
- No major weather or hazard forecasts noted.
